testcase.name: Scenario: Hide a panel while the ribbon shows compact group buttons: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:46:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide a panel while the ribbon shows compact group buttons ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon shows compact group buttons ✔ And the Parameters group button is visible ✔ When the user opens the compact ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels ✔ Then Parameters is checked ✔ When the user selects Parameters in Show Panels ✔ Then the Parameters group button disappears ✔ And the other compact group buttons remain visible and close the gap ✔ When the user returns the ribbon to its expanded display ✔ Then the Parameters panel is absent from the expanded ribbon
